app.run: Run a scratch Obeya from your worktree, never the Obeya on port 4417 (it serves the owner's canvases): `bun scripts/scratch-obeya.ts <stage.json>` (its header describes the stage file) stages a fresh repository with plan docs, a fresh OBEYA_HOME and the cards in the states you need, in about a second, and prints the `url` to open. Its page reloads by itself after a change to `src/ui/`; after a change to the server, stage afresh. Its workers are idle: a started card is in progress without an agent. Give it `--real-workers` only when the change is about what agents do; they take minutes. Stop each instance with `--stop <port>` when you are done. For a demo, keep `stage.json` in the demo directory and stage afresh before every take: call the script from the demo's `login` (`execFileSync('bun', [`${worktree}/scripts/scratch-obeya.ts`, `${import.meta.dirname}/stage.json`])`) and record against the `url` it prints. The newest `~/demos/obeya-*` is the model for the demo script. For a before and after, stage a second instance from the earlier commit with `--code <commit> --port <another port>`.
